The Title Cielo Rawai

Condominium in Rawai
HomeNew ProjectsThe Title Cielo Rawai

Project overview

Coastal condominium in Rawai with a Mediterranean-inspired concept and sea views. Shared spaces include a sky pool, rooftop, clubhouse, lobby, fitness room and kids zone.

The project was reported about 99% complete in October 2026. Prices and current availability on request via WhatsApp.
